newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Market talk boosts TVK's price, turnover.
newsitem.headline: Market talk boosts TVK's price, turnover.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian chemicals firm Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat Rt traded firmer in heavy turnover on Tuesday in what traders attributed to market talk about the imminent payout by the state to TVK.
At 1036 GMT TVK traded at 2,990 forints, up 80 forints or 2.75 percent over Monday's close with over 426,000 shares changing hands.

"TVK's price and turnover is bolstered by market talk according to which TVK will receive the five billion forints due from (privatisation agency) APV Rt this week," one trader said. "Further reason was a positive recommendation on it."
On Monday Hungary's Postabank Securities said it maintained its "buy" recommendation on TVK shares.
TVK is expected to cash in five billion forints and an additional one billion forints of accumulated interest under the provisions of Hungary's previous privatisation law.
